display_title: How to Survive as the Monster Duke's Wife
description:
Duke Bifolten, the man whose gaze alone is said to freeze anyone’s entire body. Ilyin has a prophetic dream about spending her first night with him. Because she was shunned by everyone in the mansion for her prophetic dreams, Ilyin rarely ever stepped foot outside. To think she would spend her wedding night with Duke Bifolten, a man she’s never even seen. But is Duke Bifolten really such a dangerous person? ‘He was definitely kind that night.’ Why is Duke Bifolten—the man who rules over winter with his Authority and whose sword is faster than his words—gentle only with me?

*“If you see what I look like, you will never be able to leave this castle again, Ilyin.”* I just wanted to escape that house, but now, the Master of Winter is obsessed with me.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
